notes.title: A new RTS style is born !
notes.content:
The Empire and the Kwarn, an extra-dimensional entity, will face each other in a merciless struggle.
An innovative game system for strategy enthusiasts. A neat design. A comic book atmosphere. Powerful generals. Upgradable combat drones. 2 players on the same device. ... and your dexterity in combat.
All the ingredients are there to test your tactical sense alone or against a friend!
